title: Draft Calendar, Cutoffs, Draft Caps and Notice Periods — Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Rate Sheet
content:
Draft calendar of the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, by method. All day counts are calendar days; draft times are facility local time.

| Method | Draft timing | Days before due date the draft runs | Draft submitted at | Verification cutoff (days before due date) | Revocation cutoff (days before due date) | Draft cap (USD) | Varying-amount notice period (days) | Successful draft posts on |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | On the due date | 0 | 06:00 | 1 | 1 | $1500.00 | 0 | Draft date |
| Credit Card | On the due date | 0 | 06:00 | 1 | 1 | $2500.00 | 0 | Draft date |
| Personal Checking ACH | Before the due date | 2 | 06:00 | 3 | 3 | $1500.00 | 10 | Settlement date |
| Personal Savings ACH | Before the due date | 2 | 06:00 | 3 | 3 | $1500.00 | 10 | Settlement date |
| Business Checking ACH | Before the due date | 2 | 06:00 | 3 | 3 | $10000.00 | 0 | Settlement date |
| Business Card | On the due date | 0 | 06:00 | 1 | 1 | $7500.00 | 0 | Draft date |

**Terms common to every method**

- Amount basis on the schedule: full balance due.
- Balance above the draft cap: the draft is skipped and the tenant is notified.
- Partial drafts: not allowed. Skipping a month while enrolled: not allowed.

**Definitions used in the sheet**

- *Days before due date the draft runs*: 0 means the draft runs on the due date itself (card methods); 2 means two calendar days before it (bank account methods).
- *Verification cutoff*: the number of calendar days before a due date by which the method must be verified for that period to be drafted — 1 for card methods, 3 for bank account methods.
- *Revocation cutoff*: the number of calendar days before a due date by which a revocation stops that period's draft — 1 for card methods, 3 for bank account methods.
- *Draft cap*: the largest amount drafted without the tenant's express approval; a larger balance is not drafted. The caps are $1500.00 (Debit Card, Personal Checking ACH, Personal Savings ACH), $2500.00 (Credit Card), $7500.00 (Business Card) and $10000.00 (Business Checking ACH).
- *Varying-amount notice period*: the number of calendar days before the draft date that the tenant must be told of an amount different from the last draft. It is 10 on Personal Checking ACH and Personal Savings ACH; 0 on the other methods, meaning no notice period applies to them.

**Sheet example (hypothetical dates).** For a due date on the 20th of a month, a Personal Checking ACH draft runs on the 18th at 06:00, posts on its settlement date, and the method had to be verified by the 17th for that due date to be drafted. A Credit Card draft for the same due date runs on the 20th at 06:00 and posts on the 20th.
